open_questions.question: P-OPTICS and P-CRI accepted by owner on 2026-11-14; P-SUPPLY and its technical basis remain open. Optical measurement conditions are still tracked at U14.

Panel target 15,000 h / ≥70% initial flux accepted on 2026-11-14. Define sample/population acceptance, catastrophic-failure treatment, maintenance measurement conditions remain open. Minimum replacement life is now accepted as 50 complete panel-replacement/diffuser-reclosing cycles.

External pre-fabrication electronics reviewer is not an owner prerequisite. Assign technical calculations/checks to the coordinator and four independent agent contexts; owner retains stage approval. Establish a feasible proposed fabrication/assembly route with unconfirmed constraints explicit. Name physical-test personnel before affected tests; detailed order evidence remains due at U11/U13.
Select exact laboratory-demo scope versus external qualification; identify applicable product/safety/EMC/flicker requirements without assuming old limits.

Architecture A selected by owner: isolated CC driver in base, simple LED panel. Select/verify its LED and driver implementation using power, tolerance, thermal and cost calculations; no fixed LED count or current.

Implement the product-level safety/operating criteria from U16: determine numerical circuit limits, discharge/cooling implementation, short duration/recovery, hot/cold startup and disturbance response.
Develop thermal/life calculations and detailed optical measurement procedures using the specification decisions from U14/U15; define base lifetime/end-of-life basis.

Select overtemperature behavior, thresholds and protection-fault response (including sensor faults only if a sensor is selected); define absence/reversal/partial-contact abuse cases even though live replacement is forbidden.
Freeze panel/base pin map and independently reviewed intended connectivity with exact datasheet/pin/footprint basis.
Freeze preliminary enclosure envelope, heat path/contact, insulation materials, dimensions, heights, keying and retention.
Confirm actual stackup, copper, materials and service limits as needed for insulation/layout/assembly.
Confirm available calibrated instruments, personnel, samples, test limits and stop conditions. Release evidence must cover actual operating/fault conditions.
Establish BOM availability, exact costs, release outputs, matched revisions and test/programming/assembly instructions.

Owner accepted an ordinary milky approximately 800 lm E27 lamp as distribution reference, without cap-direction emission. Select exact reference/comparison conditions; finalize CCT tolerances, stabilized optical conditions and sample plan.

Ambient 10–40°C and all orientations are accepted. Define open/ventilated-fixture assumptions and the thermal worst-case analysis/test plan at specification. Actual worst-case measurements belong to R-ENV/U12 before the affected tests and release, not before design.

Owner accepted separate base shielding: only panel/mounting accessible after diffuser removal. Define remaining normal/fault, recovery, residual-energy and cooling criteria through coordinator and independent technical reviews; implementation follows U06.

Final handover deadline 30 September 2027 accepted; the proposed staged planning baseline is recorded. Confirm actual laboratory/iteration bookings before affected work/tests, without blocking ordinary design on bookings.
